name: Solve N Cruise at Serene Alleppey 2026

venue.name: Serene Cruise, Punnamada Jetty North, Punnamada
venue.address: Serene Cruise, Punnamada Jetty North, Punnamada, Alappuzha, Kerala

information:
* Ensure your availability at the venue before the cruise starts at 10AM. Once the cruise starts, we won't be able to accommodate more onboarders.

* Once we enter the cruise boat, we can leave only upon the end of the event at 6PM.

* Traditional Kerala food will be included in the registration fees, and no outside food will be permitted inside the venue.

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.

* The competitors have to strictly adhere to the safety guidelines of the cruise.

* The competition is happening in a hall at an ultra luxury cruise boat while cruising !
